programmes.d: Based on the true story of a war waged in Mogadishu by the high-tech Black Hawk helicopters and the US Army Rangers and Deltas.
Throughout time, men have waged war. Some for power, some for glory, some for honor ... and some for love.
An ex-commando is pressed back into service when his daughter is kidnapped.
In this Robert Rodriguez/Quentin Tarantino tribute to ’70s exploitation films, a go-go dancer kills zombies in Planet Terror, and a stuntman stalks and kills women in Death Proof.
